listing.description: Sweeping panoramic views! 2 Bedrooms + Office/Bonus Room | 2 Bathrooms | 2-Car Garage  Perched high in the coveted Montclair hills, this sleek Mid-Century Modern retreat pairs clean architectural lines with truly breathtaking Bay views. From the moment you enter, floor-to-ceiling glass frames a spectacular panorama encompassing the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, Golden Gate Bridge and Richmond–San Rafael Bridge, along with Angel Island, Mt. Tamalpais and the Marin hills. The light-filled, open-concept main level is designed around the view, with a spacious living room featuring an electric fireplace and home theater, dining area and modern kitchen flowing effortlessly to an expansive deck spanning the width of the home. It’s an extraordinary setting for entertaining, dining alfresco or watching unforgettable sunsets over the Bay. The primary ensuite is on the upper level, with an additional bedroom, office/bonus room and laundry downstairs. A second, private shaded deck and fenced rear yard provide additional outdoor living space. Freshly painted inside and out, the home features beautifully refinished bamboo and maple wood floors, double-pane windows, quality finishes and appliances, a two-car garage with new automatic door, easy driveway access and ample guest parking. A private front garden and peaceful hillside setting create a wonderful sense of retreat, while Redwood Regional Park and miles of hiking and biking trails are nearby. A special Mid-Century home where architecture, privacy, indoor-outdoor living and extraordinary Bay Area views come together.

verdict: This house is the view trade: you give up square footage (1,379 sqft), hillside lot usability, and fire-zone peace of mind for a genuine living-level panoramic bay view most $1M Oakland hills listings only fake with drone shots. The 1954 post-and-beam bones, refreshed finishes, huge west-facing deck, and view-side primary suite deliver exactly the architecture + indoor-outdoor + light the brief calls for — at the cost of a flat roof, jalousie windows, power lines at the deck line, and Very High FHSZ insurance exposure. It pended in 12 days for a reason.
